howToApply: Complete the One Time Registration using the One Time Registration Login link at hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in, if not already done.
Keep scanned images of your photograph and signature, and your qualification details, ready.
Enter the required details in My Profile.
Apply for the post from Apply Now in Dashboard and follow the instructions on the screen.
Upload the required documents and check the preview of the application. No changes, editing or modification can be made after submission, and uploaded documents cannot be re-uploaded or deleted.
Take a printout of the application and keep it for future reference. The printout and documents need not be sent to the High Court.

Candidates applying from abroad must send an email giving their location with public IP address to recruitment.hckerala@nic.in to get access to the recruitment portal. They must also inform the High Court by email after completing the online application.

Closing Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank’s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.

dates.event: Commencement of submission of online application and payment of fees
Last date of submission of online application and payment of fees

howToApply: Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position.
Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website: http://www.rites.com.

While submitting the online application, the system would generate a ‘Registration No.’ on top of the online form filled up by the candidate. Note down this Registration No. and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of ‘Identity Proof’.

After filling up the required details, candidates must upload all documents under the ‘Upload Document’ section, including: High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth, Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications with mark sheets, Percentage Conversion Document (if applicable), EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate (if applicable), Proof of Identity & Address, PAN Card, Proof of experience, and any other supporting documents.
After uploading all documents, candidates are required to make online payment under the ‘Make Payment’ section.
Post successful payment of application fee, the final application form must be downloaded and a copy retained for future reference.
Applications without successful fee payment shall be treated as incomplete and shall be summarily rejected.
Hard copies of documents are NOT to be sent to the office through post/courier.
Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy. Application once submitted cannot be altered.
